exposure: Delivery mode (vaginal, elective cesarean, emergency cesarean)
cohort: The study included 148 Iranian nulliparous women.
finding: Women in the emergency cesarean group experienced higher levels of postpartum depression and PTSD symptoms compared to those with vaginal or elective cesarean deliveries, and postpartum fear of childbirth was more common among women with clinical antenatal fear of childbirth and vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women who underwent emergency cesarean delivery exhibited higher levels of postpartum depression and PTSD symptoms compared to those with vaginal or elective cesarean deliveries, while postpartum fear of childbirth was more prevalent among women with vaginal delivery in combination with clinical antenatal fear of childbirth.
